description:
Congratulations, unfortunate soul!
You're now trapped in the Sahur mansion with the most cursed zombi versions of your favorite brainrot memes. They used to make you laugh. Now they'll make you scream.

GAME FEATURES:
- Atmospheric horror with immersive sound design
- Challenging puzzles throughout the mansion
- Stealth gameplay - hide from pursuing creatures
- Discover the story through notes
- Easter eggs and references for meme lovers

These monstrosities want what's left of your rotting brain, and they're not here to ask nicely. As you explore this nightmare fuel of a house you'll need to solve puzzles while avoiding becoming another creepypasta story.

Hidden throughout this dank mansion are notes from previous visitors (spoiler: they didn't make it). Read them if you dare, but more importantly, KEEP MOVING.

Turns out those weird animals are even worse IRL. Who knew?

Solve the puzzles. Dodge the memes. Touch grass (if you ever get out).
Your brain is already rotting. Don't let them have the rest.
name: Horrorillo Brainrotillo
